title: Balanced day planner
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y5 lesson 7 (Balanced day planner (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 7: Exercise, sleep and screen time. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

head: Time
Plan (lessons, prayers, activity, screen-free time, bedtime)

keywords.def: habits that help us sleep well
the right amount of each thing

questions.q: Give two ways to be active between online lessons.
questions.a: Stretching, star jumps, a walk in the garden.

questions.q: Why charge devices outside the bedroom?
questions.a: So they do not keep you awake or tempt you to use them.

questions.q: Core: Plan a balanced school day with lessons, prayers, activity, screen-free time and bedtime (pupil PDF).
questions.a: A plan with 60 minutes activity, screens off an hour before bed, 9 or more hours of sleep.

questions.q: Extend: Track your screen time for one evening and suggest one change.
questions.a: A record and one realistic change.

questions.q: Stretch: Explain how poor sleep could affect learning the next day.
Best time to stop screens before bed?
questions.a: B) About an hour before. An hour gives the brain time to wind down.

questions.q: Children should be active for about... A) 10 minutes B) 60 minutes C) 5 hours a day
Big question: is all screen time the same? Give one difference.
questions.a: No: learning is different from late-night gaming, which harms sleep.
